content:
Question: How do I purchase the Ather 450X?

Answer: You first need to reserve by booking one at a fully refundable amount of ₹2,500. Your order is then created. Depending on your order's sequence in the queue and Ather's delivery schedule, you will be notified via email or call when your order is ready for purchase completion. The booking token money is adjusted against the final amount you pay.

Question: How do I check my order status?

Answer: Once you've booked, sign up to activate your Ather account using the same email ID and phone number you used when booking. All order details will be available on your dashboard.

Question: Can I buy more than one scooter?

Answer: Yes. For every scooter, make a separate booking. There is no restriction on the number of bookings per person. However, each person can only avail the PM E-DRIVE subsidy once, as it is linked to one's Aadhaar ID.

Question: My booking was made in a different name. Can I change it?

Answer: Yes. After booking, you can change ownership details by contacting Ather's customer support team (for Bengaluru and Chennai) or the dealer partner (for other cities), as long as full payment has not been made. Once invoiced, ownership details can only be changed at the time of resale.

doc_name: Purchase - Pricing, Subsidy & Cost of Ownership
content:
Question: Is the ex-showroom price inclusive or exclusive of PM E-DRIVE subsidy?

Answer: The ex-showroom price on the Ather website is inclusive of PM E-DRIVE subsidy, other applicable subsidies, and GST. It does not include registration fees, road tax, and insurance.

Question: Will I get a PM E-DRIVE subsidy?

Answer: Yes. Ather 450X is PM E-DRIVE compliant and eligible for a subsidy of approximately ₹10,000. This amount has already been applied to the ex-showroom price on the website. Additionally, Ather 450X may be eligible for state government EV subsidies in certain states.

Question: Is the cost of owning an Ather 450X comparable to a petrol scooter?

Answer: A typical petrol scooter costs ₹2.2/km to run, whereas the Ather 450X Gen 3 costs just ₹0.2/km. If you ride 100 km a week, you save more than ₹10,000 on fuel every year. While the upfront cost may be higher than a comparable petrol scooter, the daily savings will easily cover the difference.

Question: Do I need a license to ride the Ather 450X?

Answer: Yes. The Ather 450X has a top speed of 90 km/h, so a valid driver's license and number plate registration are mandatory. Only electric scooters with a motor of 250W or less and a top speed of 25 km/h or below are exempt from license requirements.

Question: Do you offer loan and lease options for the Ather 450X?

Answer: Yes. Ather has six loan partners: IDFC First Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Cholamandalam, Jana Small Finance Bank, and Hero FinCorp, available in all cities. Ather also partners with Autovert to offer lease options across all cities. Details are available on atherenergy.com.

Question: What is the interest rate for an Ather scooter EMI?

Answer: The interest rate for Ather scooters typically ranges between 3.99% to 10.99%, depending on your credit score, lender, tenure, and type of scheme. Use the Ather EMI calculator on the website to compare plans.

Question: Can I buy an Ather with zero down payment?

Answer: Yes. You can buy an Ather electric scooter with zero down payment through Flexipay. EMI plans are available through leading banks and NBFCs including Axis Bank, Bajaj Finserv, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, IDFC First Bank, Hero FinCorp, Tata Capital, L&T Finance, Cholamandalam, and ev.Fin by Greaves.

Question: How do I buy the Ather on EMI?

Answer: Select your preferred model online or visit the nearest Ather showroom. Choose a suitable EMI plan based on your budget, submit the required documents, pick your preferred loan tenure and confirm the monthly EMI. You can also use the Ather EMI Calculator on atherenergy.com.

Question: What is the standard vehicle warranty on Ather scooters?

Answer: All Ather scooters come with a standard warranty of 3 years or 30,000 km, whichever comes first.

Question: What is covered under vehicle warranty?

Answer: All vehicle parts (excluding wear and tear parts) are covered. Wear and tear parts not covered include: primary belt, secondary belt, brake pads, brake shoes, bulbs, rubber and plastic parts, consumables like oil and grease, tyres, and painted parts.

Question: Can my vehicle warranty become void?

Answer: Yes, warranty can become void if you: miss periodic services as recommended by Ather; use the scooter for commercial purposes (taxi, fleet, motorsports, goods delivery) without a special agreement; expose the vehicle to harsh environmental factors (industrial pollution, acidic environment, excessive moisture or sun); park or ride in water-logged roads with water above floorboard level; load the vehicle beyond defined limits; or cause damage from external impact.

Question: What is Extended Component Warranty (ECW)?

Answer: ECW is a protection plan covering key electronic and mechanical components — motor, controller, charger, dashboard, and wiring — for 5 years or 60,000 km. It provides zero repair or replacement costs and cashless claims. Ather owners can purchase ECW within the first 90 days of vehicle purchase via the Ather App or by calling 7676 600 900.

Question: What is covered under battery warranty?

Answer: Ather Battery Warranty covers replacement or repair of batteries damaged due to manufacturing defects, workmanship errors, or if the battery's State-of-Health falls below 70% within the coverage period. This is free of cost, inclusive of labour charges.

Question: What is NOT covered under battery warranty?

Answer: Not covered: damages from customer negligence (except deep discharge due to idle state); modifications or alterations to the battery; deletion or alteration of VIN or BIN numbers; situations such as theft, abuse, accident, flooding, or fire; battery's natural wear and tear; physical damage to parts.

Question: What battery warranty does the Ather 450S come with?

Answer: Without AtherStack Pro: 3 years or 30,000 km. With AtherStack Pro: 5 years or 60,000 km. With AtherStack Pro + Eight70 Warranty add-on (₹4,999): 8 years or 80,000 km.

Question: How can I check my battery health?

Answer: Battery health data is reliable only after the vehicle has completed 10,000 km. Contact Ather customer support at 7676 600 900 and they will help you with it.

Question: What is Eight70 Warranty?

Answer: Eight70 Warranty is a comprehensive 8-year battery warranty plan that extends the standard 3-year battery warranty by an additional 5 years. In total, you get 8 years or 80,000 km of coverage (whichever comes first). If battery health falls below 70% at any point within the 8 years, Ather will replace the battery for free — no questions asked. It is an add-on purchasable with AtherStack Pro.

Question: What are the key features of Eight70 Warranty?

Answer: Features include: 8 years/80,000 km total coverage; covers both battery failures AND degradation (first in the industry); covers all battery defects (cell, electrical, electronic, BMS); idle state assurance — no claim rejection due to deep discharge from vehicle being left uncharged; no upper limit on claim amount; transferable to a new owner if you sell the scooter.

Question: What is NOT covered under Eight70 Warranty?

Answer: Not covered: customer negligence damages (except idle-state deep discharge); modifications or alterations to the battery; deletion or alteration of VIN/BIN; theft, abuse, accident, flooding, fire; battery natural wear and tear; physical damage.

Question: How do I claim Eight70 Warranty?

Answer: Bring your scooter to the nearest Ather Service Centre and describe your battery concerns. The service centre will check validity and applicability. Once verified, Ather will repair or replace the part free of charge. The warranty start date is based on the vehicle invoice date. The warranty certificate is mailed to owners within 30 days of invoice.

Question: What is the charger warranty duration?

Answer: All Ather chargers (including portable and Ather Dot) come with a standard warranty of 3 years.

Question: What is NOT covered under charger warranty?

Answer: Physical damage to the charger is not covered. The Ather service centre will inspect the charger before providing warranty service.

Question: How can I extend my charger warranty?

Answer: You can extend charger warranty by opting for the Extended Component Warranty (ECW) plan, which covers the charger along with other key components (motor, controller, dashboard, wiring) for 5 years or 60,000 km. It ensures zero repair or replacement costs and cashless claims.

Question: Is Ather Connect mandatory?

Answer: No, it is optional. However, Ather Connect unlocks features including Find My Scooter, OTA software updates, Call and Music Controls, Google Maps navigation, Theft and Tow detection, and more.

Question: How long do I get Ather Connect for free?

Answer: If you bought a new Ather scooter with AtherStack Pro, you receive 3 years of complimentary Ather Connect from the date of purchase. After that, you need to subscribe.

Question: What subscription plans are available for Ather Connect?

Answer: Ather offers quarterly, annual, and 3-year plans. There is no monthly plan. Plans cannot be paused once active. Upgrades from 1-year to 3-year plans can only be done at the time of renewal. Downgrades are not possible.

Question: Can I pay for Ather Connect with Ather Credits?

Answer: Yes, Ather Credits can be used to pay for Ather Connect subscriptions.

Question: How long does Ather Connect activation take after payment?

Answer: It activates within a couple of minutes of payment. If it doesn't, contact customer support at 7676 600 900.

Question: How do I download and install the Ather App?

Answer: Download the Ather App from the Google Play Store (Android) or Apple App Store (iOS) — search for 'Ather' and tap Install/Get.

Question: What are the minimum phone requirements for the Ather App?

Answer: Android: OS version 10 or newer. iOS: version 16 or newer.

Question: How do I log in to the Ather App?

Answer: For vehicle owners, log in with your registered mobile number — you will receive an OTP to verify. If you don't know your registered mobile number or no longer have access to it, contact customercare@atherenergy.com.

Question: Can I log in on multiple devices?

Answer: Yes. The Ather App supports multi-device login. You and your family members can access the app from multiple smartphones simultaneously.

Question: How do I deactivate my Ather app account?

Answer: Open the Ather App → Profile → Settings → Manage Account → Deactivate. On deactivation, no new data will be collected but existing data is retained. Your Ather Connect subscription continues until its expiry. Ather Credits remain valid and expire per their original deadline.

Question: How do I delete my Ather app account?

Answer: Open the Ather App → Profile → Settings → Manage Account → Delete. On deletion, all previously collected data is erased. Active Ather Connect subscriptions will elapse. Ather Credits will elapse. Note: Credits expire after 180 days of account deactivation.

Question: When can I NOT deactivate or delete my account?

Answer: Only when you have pending payment charges for charging sessions on Ather Grids. Clear the charge first, then proceed.

Question: Can I still get customer support after deactivation?

Answer: Yes. Contact Ather support at customercare@atherenergy.com or call +91 7676 600 900.

Question: How do I reactivate a deactivated account?

Answer: Open the Ather App and log in with your credentials to reactivate. For a deleted account, you will need to sign up again.

Question: What is Ather Care?

Answer: Ather Care is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) plan for Ather 450 series scooters (450, 450 Plus, 450S, 450X, 450 Apex). Plans expire in 12 months or 10,000 km from purchase, whichever comes first.

Question: What parts get discounts under Ather Care?

Answer: Wear & Tear parts eligible for discount include: Wheel Pulley, Intermediate Pulley, Primary Belt, Secondary Belt, Brake Pads (Front & Rear), Motor Pulley, Wheel Bearings (Front & Rear), Front Fork Oil Seal. Accessory fitting charges are NOT discounted.

Question: What are the restrictions on Ather Care?

Answer: Benefits can only be used at the service centre where the plan was purchased. Upgrades and downgrades are not possible while the plan is active. Cancellations can only be requested within 24 hours of purchase. The free periodic maintenance benefit requires at least 4,700 km driven since the previous service interval. Plans can be purchased at authorised Ather Service Centres (not via the Ather App).

Question: What is the home charging solution for Ather scooters?

Answer: Every Ather scooter comes with a portable charger that works with any 5A plug point. It can be carried in the scooter's boot. A 15A socket (with adaptor) charges faster.

Question: How much does it cost to charge the Ather 450X at home?

Answer: The portable charger consumes around 4 kWh of electricity for a full charge of the Ather 450X. At ₹4–8 per kWh, one full charge costs approximately ₹20–₹35.

Question: How long does home charging take for the Ather 450X?

Answer: Using a 15A socket: approximately 5 hours 45 minutes for 0–100%. Using a 5A socket, it takes longer.

Question: How long does home charging take for the Ather 450S?

Answer: Home charging (0–80%): approximately 6 hours 36 minutes. Full charge (0–100%): approximately 8 hours 36 minutes.

Question: What is the Ather Duo charger?

Answer: The Ather Duo is a 700W home charger that is a 2-in-1 wall-mounted and portable charger. You can carry it as a portable charger or dock it on a wall mount and lock it for plug-and-charge convenience. It is faster than the older 350W charger.

Question: Is the Ather Duo compatible with my scooter?

Answer: Yes, the Ather Duo is compatible with all generations of Ather scooters, regardless of range or battery size. It will charge them at 700W.

Question: How much does the Ather Duo cost?

Answer: Charger only: ₹13,999. Wall mount only: ₹2,599. Bundled kit (charger + wall mount): ₹14,999. The Ather Duo comes standard with the 450X high range kit; other model purchasers can buy it as an accessory.

Question: What is the warranty on the Ather Duo?

Answer: The Ather Duo charger has a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. The wall mount has a 1-year warranty. Damage to cables, plug, RCD, and connector due to wear and tear is not covered.

Question: Can I use my existing 700W charger with the Ather Duo wall mount?

Answer: No. The wall mount is designed specifically for the Ather Duo charger.

doc_name: Charging - Ather Grid Fast Charging & Payments
content:
Question: How fast can I charge at an Ather Grid public station?

Answer: The Ather 450X charges at 1.5 km/min at Ather Grid (measured from 0–50% SOC). A charge from 0–80% takes approximately 1 hour 10 minutes. Ather Grid is India's largest two-wheeler fast-charging network with 1,800+ charging points across 100+ cities. Locate the nearest point via the Ather app or dashboard navigation.

Question: How much does Ather Grid fast charging cost?

Answer: Ather Grid fast charging is ₹1/min plus 18% GST. There are no additional processing fees. Rates may change based on location or offers.

Question: How do I pay for Ather Grid charging?

Answer: Download the Ather App and log in. Find a charger near you on the app. You start with a balance of ₹100 on your Ather App. Once this balance runs out, reload it using standard payment methods (card, UPI, etc.) to continue charging.

Question: I have more than one Ather — how much balance do I get?

Answer: You get ₹100 balance per scooter, for up to 3 scooters — so a maximum of ₹300 in total.

Question: Can I still charge at Ather Grid if I don't reload my balance?

Answer: No. Once the available balance is exhausted and not reloaded, you can no longer use fast charging Ather Grid points.

Question: How do I subscribe to Ather RSA?

Answer: Purchase the RSA plan from the Ather App or from your nearest Ather Experience Centre. Note: RSA redemptions have a mandatory 15-day waiting period after purchase.

Question: How do I request RSA in an emergency?

Answer: Call 7676 811 777 or place a request through the Ather App.

Question: What situations does Ather RSA cover?

Answer: RSA covers: flat tyre, charge runout (towed to nearest Ather touchpoint), scooter breakdown, and accident cases. There is no limit on the number of RSA requests within the 12-month plan period.

Question: Is there a distance limit for RSA towing?

Answer: RSA is free up to 100 km from the nearest Ather touchpoint. Beyond 100 km, you are charged ₹22 per additional kilometre. Night-time RSA has no extra charge.

Question: How quickly will RSA reach me?

Answer: Within city limits: Ather aims to reach within 60 minutes. Outside city limits: approximately 150 minutes.

Question: Where is my scooter taken after RSA picks it up?

Answer: It is towed to the nearest Ather Space, Service Centre, Ather Grid, or wherever the situation demands. For safety, the scooter is checked before being returned to you.

Question: What is Ather TPMS and how does it help?

Answer: Ather TPMS is a pair of internal tyre pressure sensors that alert you when tyre pressure is high or low. Maintaining ideal tyre pressure improves range, suspension response, and overall ride quality. Every 2 PSI drop in pressure reduces range by 2–3%. TPMS is compatible with the Ather 450X when upgraded to AtherStack Pro.

Question: How much does Ather TPMS cost and what is the warranty?

Answer: Ather TPMS costs ₹4,999 inclusive of GST. Installation is complimentary. It comes with a 1-year warranty from the date of installation. Installation takes 4–6 hours at an authorised Ather Service Centre (not available at local garages — doing so voids the warranty).

Question: How long does the TPMS battery last?

Answer: The TPMS has a non-replaceable battery expected to last 3–5 years.

Question: What happens to TPMS during a tyre change or wheel rotation?

Answer: TPMS does not need to be moved during a tyre change, but during a rim change it must be fitted to the new rims. After wheel rotation, TPMS sensors are re-paired at the service centre. If one sensor is damaged, both must be replaced (TPMS can only be bought in pairs).

Question: What helmets does Ather sell and how much do they cost?

Answer: Ather offers two styles of helmets available at Ather Experience Centres: Half-face helmet: ₹2,299. Full-face helmet: ₹2,999. Helmets come in 3 sizes — M (570mm), L (580mm), and XL (600mm).

Question: What certifications do Ather helmets have?

Answer: Ather helmets are ISI (IS: 4151) certified and undergo Impact Absorption, Rigidity, and Retention tests. Features include a UV-resistant visor with single-hand operation, plush lycra interiors with breathable padding, and a high-quality paint finish.

Question: What is the warranty on Ather helmets?

Answer: 2 years from the date of purchase. To claim warranty, produce the invoice at the nearest Ather Experience Centre.

Question: What is the Ather Frunk and how much does it cost?

Answer: The Frunk is a front storage solution designed for Ather scooters in collaboration with Wildcraft. It has 14L storage capacity with compartments for a water bottle, sunglasses, and a water-resistant mobile phone pocket. Made of 100% polyester Ripstop material, water-resistant under heavy rainfall, and can hold up to 5 kg. Cost: ₹2,999 inclusive of GST and installation. Compatible with all Ather scooters. Comes with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

Question: What is the Ather Side Step and how much does it cost?

Answer: The Ather Side Step is a seamlessly designed, single-cast aluminum side step with a premium rubber surface for grip and a high-quality bi-directional spring for hands-free opening and closing. Cost: ₹2,199 inclusive of GST and installation. Compatible with Ather 450X and Plus Gen 3 and future versions only. Comes with a 1-year warranty from date of invoicing.

Question: What is Ather BodyGuard?

Answer: Ather BodyGuard is a protective film for 4 sections on each side of the vehicle, protecting against mild scratches under normal touch-and-fall scenarios. It is rain-resistant and can withstand pressure washing. Comes with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects and peeling. Installation must be done at an Ather service centre.

Question: What is Paint Protection Film (PPF) for Ather scooters?

Answer: PPF is a durable, transparent, virtually invisible thermoplastic urethane film applied to painted surfaces. It protects against minor scratches, stone chips, road debris, insect stains, bird droppings, and swirl marks from cleaning.

Question: Does PPF change the look of my scooter or turn yellow?

Answer: No — PPF is optically clear and designed to be virtually invisible. It has UV inhibitors to resist yellowing. If unexpected yellowing occurs, Ather covers it under warranty. The film has self-healing properties: minor scratches disappear with exposure to heat from the sun or warm water.

Question: How much does PPF cost and where can I get it installed?

Answer: PPF can be purchased at Ather Experience Centres or Service Centres. Installation is done exclusively at Ather Service Centres and authorised third-party vendors. Installation takes a few hours. Self-installation is strongly discouraged and voids the warranty. PPF covers all painted body parts (headlights and non-painted parts are excluded).

Question: How do I care for my scooter after PPF installation?

Answer: Wait 48 hours before washing. Use pH-neutral shampoo with a soft microfiber cloth. Avoid high-pressure water near film edges, abrasive cleaners, solvent-based cleaners, or rough sponges. Periodic maintenance every 6 months is mandatory for warranty coverage.

Question: Where can I buy Ather merchandise?

Answer: Ather merchandise can be purchased online at shop.atherenergy.com. It is not available for purchase at Ather Experience Centres (Spaces).

Question: What merchandise is available and what are the prices?

Answer: Ather offers T-shirts ranging from ₹1,299 to ₹1,499, available in sizes XS, S, M, L, XL, and XXL.

Question: What is the return and exchange policy for merchandise?

Answer: There is no return policy, but if merchandise doesn't fit well or is damaged, Ather will arrange a replacement. Contact 7676 600 900 or info@atherenergy.com with your order details.

Question: Do I need to own an Ather scooter to buy merchandise?

Answer: No. Anyone can purchase Ather merchandise.

Question: Can I use Ather Credits to buy merchandise?

Answer: No, Ather Credits cannot currently be used to purchase merchandise.

Question: What is the value of each Ather Credit?

Answer: 1 Ather Credit = ₹1.

Question: What can I purchase using Ather Credits?

Answer: Credits can be used to: renew or purchase new Ather Connect subscription plans; purchase TPMS; and other upcoming accessories and merchandise.

Question: What CANNOT be purchased with Ather Credits?

Answer: Credits cannot be used for vehicle service, spare parts, or merchandise (currently).

Question: Can I make a partial payment with credits?

Answer: Yes. You can pay a partial amount using credits and the rest with cash, card, or other payment methods.

Question: What are 'locked' and 'redeemed' credits?

Answer: Referral credits are 'unlocked' when the referred customer completes their vehicle purchase. Credits become 'redeemed' when used to purchase subscriptions or accessories. Credits expire after 180 days of account deactivation.

Question: What are the variants of the Ather 450X?

Answer: The Ather 450X is available in two power/range variants: 126 km IDC range and 161 km IDC range. The standard variant has a 2.9 kWh battery with 146 km IDC range (Eco mode); real-world city range is 85–105 km. The 450X Pro adds Warp mode.

Question: What are the riding modes on the Ather 450X?

Answer: The 450X has four riding modes: Eco (max 45 km/h, max range), Ride (60 km/h, regular city use), Sport (80 km/h, increased acceleration), and Warp (90 km/h, 0–60 km/h in 5.1 seconds — only on 450X Pro).

Question: What connectivity features does the Ather 450X have?

Answer: The 450X has a 7-inch touchscreen dashboard with Android Auto support, Google Maps turn-by-turn navigation with live traffic, call and music controls, real-time TPMS (if installed), OTA software updates via Wi-Fi, and the Ather App for remote monitoring (battery level, trip history, charging status) via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

Question: What safety features does the Ather 450X include?

Answer: Combined Braking System (CBS), IP67-rated battery, geo-fencing alerts, theft detection via the Ather app, tow alerts, crash detection, side-stand motor cut-off, FallSafe™ (cuts power if rider falls — can be enabled/disabled from dashboard), and tubeless MRF tyres on 12-inch alloy wheels.

Question: What is the difference between the Ather 450X and 450S?

Answer: The 450S is a more affordable variant in the 450 series. Key differences: the 450S has turn-by-turn navigation but does NOT support live traffic (Google Maps live traffic is only on the 450X). The 450X comes with TPMS option and faster charging options. Both models can charge at Ather Grid.

Question: How long does it take to charge the Ather 450S?

Answer: Home charging: 0–80% in 6 hours 36 minutes; 0–100% in 8 hours 36 minutes. Fast charging at Ather Grid: same speed as the Ather 450X.

Question: Can I use an older 700W charger with the Ather 450S?

Answer: Yes. The 700W charger is compatible with all Ather scooters. With it, charging takes 4 hours 30 minutes (0–100%) or 3 hours 30 minutes (0–80%).

Question: What is the service interval for the Ather 450S?

Answer: Ather recommends servicing every 5,000 km.

Question: What is the Ather 450 Apex?

Answer: The 450 Apex is Ather's flagship scooter. It comes with AtherStack Pro built-in (no need to purchase separately). IDC range: 157 km (improved from 450X's 150 km). TrueRange: Eco 110 km, Ride 95 km, Sport 90 km. Top speed: 100 km/h in Warp+ mode.

Question: Is the 450 Apex eligible for PM E-DRIVE subsidy?

Answer: No. The ex-factory price of the 450 Apex does not qualify for PM E-DRIVE subsidy as per the scheme's guidelines.

Question: What is Magic Twist on the 450 Apex?

Answer: Magic Twist is a feature where regenerative braking kicks in to send power back to the battery pack during deceleration, improving overall range.

Question: Are new 450 Apex features available as an OTA update on my 450X?

Answer: No. The new features of the 450 Apex are not backward compatible with the 450X.

Question: What is the first service interval for the 450 Apex?

Answer: Like all other Ather scooters, the first service is recommended at 5,000 km.

Question: Where can I find Ather service centres?

Answer: Ather has authorised service centres in 100+ cities across India. To find the nearest one: open the Ather App → tap 'Service' → tap 'Find Service Centre'; or visit atherenergy.com/service-centres and enter your city; or call Ather support at 7676 600 900.

Question: What is the service schedule for Ather scooters?

Answer: Ather recommends service every 6 months or 5,000 km, whichever comes first. The first free service is at 750 km or 1 month. Unlike petrol scooters, there is no engine oil, spark plugs, or air filter to replace. Regular maintenance covers brake inspection, tyre pressure check, throttle and brake cable check, and software updates. Always use an authorised Ather service centre.

Question: Is doorstep service available?

Answer: Doorstep service is available in select cities. Check the Ather App for availability in your area.

Question: How do I claim warranty for my Ather scooter or parts?

Answer: Visit the nearest authorised Ather service centre with your vehicle Registration Certificate and purchase invoice. The service team will diagnose the issue. If covered under warranty, repair or replacement is done at no cost (inclusive of labour). Warranty claims cannot be processed at third-party or general mechanic shops.

Question: How do I contact Ather for support or warranty issues?

Answer: Call: 7676 600 900 (24/7 for RSA emergencies; regular support during business hours). Email: customercare@atherenergy.com. You can also raise issues via the Ather App. Ather Experience Centres are open Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–6 PM.

Question: Can I cancel my Ather order and get a refund?

Answer: Yes, you can cancel before full payment is made and the vehicle is registered. The ₹2,500 booking amount is fully refundable if cancelled before the vehicle is invoiced. To cancel, contact your Ather Experience Centre or call 7676 600 900. After the vehicle has been delivered and registered, it cannot be returned.

Question: Can I change the model or variant of my existing order?

Answer: Yes. Contact the Experience Centre where you placed your order to make the change.

Question: What documents are needed for registration and how long does it take?

Answer: Ather handles vehicle registration on your behalf. Required documents: Aadhaar card, address proof, passport-size photographs, and purchase invoice. A temporary registration is issued at delivery (valid 30 days). The permanent RC is delivered within 30–60 days. HSRP (High Security Registration Plate) is fixed at delivery.

Question: What insurance does the Ather 450X come with?

Answer: Third-party insurance (mandatory by law) is bundled with the purchase for 1 year. Comprehensive insurance (own damage + third-party) is strongly recommended and available through Ather's insurance partners at purchase. The Ather App sends renewal reminders. PPF is not covered under standard insurance — check with your insurer for add-ons.

Question: Is comprehensive insurance necessary?

Answer: Third-party insurance is legally mandatory. Comprehensive insurance (covering own damage) is optional but strongly recommended to protect against accidents, theft, and damage.
